lines.en: AND ALSO RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS!

: Hello and welcome back from that very brief word from our sponsor!
: I’m joined here today by Molly MacCormack! Who, after a very thorough check, I have confirmed is definitely a girl!
: Druid first. Girl second.
: And virgin third.
: Geh.
: Now, the point of this game is simple. I...think. But I don’t know anything about D&D. So why don’t you take it away and set the stage for us, Molly?
: With pleasure! For setting the stage is the single most important responsibility of any dungeon master!
: And one must always be willing to craft an experience that is not just entirely welcoming to new players, but exciting and dramatic as well!
: This will, however, be the first time I have ever DMed for two people with zero interest in the game. So there is a chance this crashes and burns rather quickly.
: On the bright side, I doubt it can go worse than the cooking competition.
: I regret nothing and feel as if I was able to get much closer to Yumi today.
: Oh yeah? Then where is she?
: I don’t know!
: She ran away after I took my eye off of her. But I’ll get her back, I swear. It just...might take about eight years or so.
: So, what are the rules of this again? Noriko gave me a brief rundown of how the game works last night, but I still don’t really get it.
: I’ll set the stage in just a moment, but the main idea is that the character you created will be fighting against the character Chika created for a chance to marry the princess!
: You mean like in Shrek?
: No! Not like Shrek!
: I mean, it’s a little like Shrek. Like when Fiona was going to marry Lord Farquad and then Shrek and Donkey had to make it all the way to Duloc to stop the wedding.
: That...
: Wasn’t there also a scene like that in Wayne’s World 2 where Wayne has to stop Cassandra from getting married?
: What a weird thing to keep typecasting Mike Myers for.
: Guys, stop interrupting Molly. She was just about to get to the plot.
: It’s the same thing, isn’t it?
: The...scene begins in...a cathedral...
: Just before the princess is wed to Kirin’s character — Elenna Everbloom, a cynical and misunderstood warlock from deep within the forests of Sheenalion...
: But...just before the wedding begins...Chika’s character and true love of the princess, Yahtel Vorrinn, storms the cathedral with her animal companion and...
: And challenges Elenna to a battle to the death.
: Isn’t Chika’s character a dragon lady?
: Mhm. With a mule as a combat pet thingy. Who I did name Theodore originally, but I’m just going to call him Donkey now.
: So Chika’s Shrek and I’m Lord Farquad. Got it.
: Did you plagiarize Shrek thinking you could get it by us, Molly?
: You did, didn’t you?
: I have been struggling creatively as of late. And I had less than twenty-four hours to come up with something, so...
: Yes. Chika is Shrek and Kirin is Lord Farquad.
: Begin!
: Wait, how? Do I just, like...say I attack her and you decide if I succeed?
: Assuming the two of you will be skipping any roleplay, both characters must first roll for initiative to determine who acts first.
: Okay. How do I do-
: That’s...sixteen.
: Hey, no fair. Kirin already knows how to play.
: Like I said, Noriko showed me the ropes last night. Rolling dice isn’t exactly difficult and that’s all we’ve done so far.
: Does it matter which one? There are so many different kinds.
: The one with the skull on it next to your water. That’s a D20.
: This one?
: Mhm. Pick that up and roll it.
: Prepare to die, Lord Farquad.
: Elenna! Elenna Everbloom! At least get her name right!
: That’s a...5!
: Oh no. It’s already happening.
: Once Yahtel bursts her way into the cathedral, she’s surprised to find Elenna already lying in wait after receiving word from the royal scouts about an intruder approaching!
: But what she’s even more surprised to find is her one true love, Princess Shadre of Sheurchester, cowering in the corner of the room as a curse overtakes her body!
: Ngh! H...Help! I’m...turning into...an ogre!
: That is not what the curse is supposed to be! But I suppose it does not matter much in this moment! Just kill each other! Kirin goes first!
: I attack Shrek with eldritch blast.
: And it lands on a...seventeen.
: You’re normally supposed to roleplay your actions and stuff. The game isn’t really fun if you just name your attacks and move on.
: But you specifically told me that playing this warlock class was as easy as just saying “eldritch blast” over and over.
: Hey! You have to do other stuff sometimes! I used mage hand once!
: What does that do? Do I have that? Should I use that instead?
: It just makes a magic hand that floats around and does regular hand stuff.
: Can you fuck it?
: Ew! Obviously not, Kirin!
: I mean...you could. You can kind of just...fuck anything in D&D so long as the DM allows it.
: It just makes people uncomfortable a lot of the time and you probably shouldn’t.
: I take back everything I said about how this game is for virgins, Molly. It’s totally cool and normal to sit at a table with your friends and pretend to have sex with ghost hands together.
: There’s obviously more to it than that! Kirin, your eldritch blast connects with Yahtel! Roll for damage! And include at least some form of narration about it!
: Noriko, which dice do I-
: These. Here. You have three beams, so you roll one d10 for each.
: Thanks.
: That’s...wow, really? All those dice and I only got 10 after adding everything up?
: Welcome to D&D. Now make it sound more fun than just blasting Chika and keeping your mouth shut.
: Uhh, okay. I...raise up my staff or whatever and-
: You don’t have a staff, Kirin. Look at your sheet. This part shows you where-
: I-I see it! I just don’t get how the fuck I cast the spell at all then!
: It comes out of your hand. Like this — PACHEW! Boom. Perfect eldritch blast noise.
: Fucking...PACHEW! There. I hit Shrek.
: Ouch. My ogrish body has received your attack. Thankfully, I am covered in onion-like layers that protect me from receiving full damage.
: No, you still receive the full 10 points of damage. But I am grateful that you made more of an attempt to narrate than Kirin did.
: What the fuck do you want from me?! This is embarrassing enough as is!
: What do I do now, Rin? I don’t have that blast thing too, do I?
: Nope! You’re a ranger, so you’re going to want to attack Lord Farquad with your bow and your lovable donkey companion voiced by Eddie Murphy.
: Use your action to attack with your bow first. Then, once that’s resolved, tell Molly you want to use your bonus action to command your donkey to attack.
: She’ll tell you what to roll and when. But chances are, since you’re sitting next to me and I am cursed, you’re only going to roll fives. I am so sorry.
: You’re so cute.
: What? Huh?
: I just don’t see you get this excited about stuff often. And I think it’s really impressive how much you know about this game.
: I actually kind of suck. Molly’s the impressive one out of everybody here. She’s the one you want to be complimenting.
: Nah. I think you’re cuter than her.
: Kiss.
: Um, hello? I am right here.
: I want them to kiss.
: I use my next turn to fuck my mage hand.
: Yahtel hasn’t even rolled to hit yet! You must wait for her turn to resolve before fucking anything!
: But let it also be known that using your turn in such a way puts you at an even greater disadvantage than you already are going up against two characters at once! Chika-
: Five!
: Miss! Are you still using your bonus action on an attack for Donkey?! I MEAN...THEODORE!
: I guess so! I’m not really sure what else to do, so I’m just listening to Rin.
: Roll again!
: That’s...five? Wow, Rin. You really are cursed, aren’t you?
: How joyous it is to watch so many attractive women pretending to both be and slay hideous monsters.
: They’re not all monsters, Tsuneyo. I’m pretty sure Kirin’s playing an elf based on her name and origin.
: Ahh, yes. I have heard that you are particularly attracted to that mythical race.
: Is there something different about their genitals? Or do you simply enjoy the sounds of the forest?
: You read one book with elf sex and suddenly everyone won’t stop talking about how it's your entire sexual personality. What is my life now?
: At least you do not have sexual intercourse with ghosts or continuously wake up without your clothes on. I believe that is my “sexual personality” now.
: I’m sorry, what?
: I have also learned I am not very good at masturbating. I don’t think I fully understand it. But I am trying, and I believe that is what counts.
: I’m sorry, what?
: Forgive me. I neglected to take into consideration the fact that you may not yet understand what masturbation is. It was only a short while ago that I too-
: Tsuneyo, I know what it is! But it’s not a thing you should just openly discuss with other people like that!
: It’s not?
: No! Which is why I’m so thrown off by how everyone around me keeps doing it all of a sudden! Like, who cares if I don’t have any sex toys?! It doesn’t matter!
: There are toys now? This is news to me.
: No. And don’t look them up either. I am a liar and I was lying to you.
: I did not realize sex was so popular that it had been licensed for physical goods. It is no wonder so many of you have been fornicating with the teacher.
: No one is fornicating with the teacher, Tsuneyo.
: Not the female one. The male one who no longer comes here. Probably because he is too busy fornicating with women.
: I repeat — no one is fornicating with the teacher, Tsuneyo.
: I am.
: You’re what?! Since when?!
: Since before the golden noodle trap. Though it seems as if it is all just in my head. I believe there may be something wrong with my brain.
: There’s nothing wrong with your brain, Tsuneyo...It’s normal for girls our age to start getting curious about stuff like that. It’s just...normally done in private.
: I do not understand why. Would it not make more sense for all of us to just fornicate with one another if doing so would positively impact our mental and physical health?
: I’m sure there are many girls in our class who would be very excited to hear you say that. But I am not one of them.
: A purebred man-fucker. Impressive.
: Will you show me how?
: No! And I encourage you not to ask anyone else either since it can’t possibly lead to anything good!
: I see. I suppose that might explain why I keep blacking out and waking up without my clothes on then.
: See a doctor about that! It’s not something I can help you with and...sounds extremely dangerous! And...also cold.
: I will ask the female teacher. She seems particularly fascinated with my body. Perhaps she knows how to fix it?
: Definitely don't drag Miss Imai into this! I like her and I don’t want her getting in trouble!
: That is...23 points of damage total. I think.
: Hah...
: What? Is that bad? Can I heal?
: Yeah, it’s bad. You just died. Now Lord Farquad gets to marry Fiona and it’s going to throw the entire world into chaos. Probably.
: Wait, I won?! Really?!
: Thanks in no small part to Chika setting the record for most consecutive fives rolled in a row.
: Second most consecutive fives rolled in a row. The true record belong to Nithhala with a grand total of 3,325.
: Hell yeah, Kirin! Great job making up for the point your roommate lost us when she chose friendship over family!
: Good game, Kirin. It was nice being able to fight against you without either one of us calling the other a slut at all.
: Sorry for being an omen of bad luck, Chika. This dark cloud follows me wherever I go and I will never escape its grasp.
: Don’t apologize, Rin! I wouldn’t have been able to play at all without you. I had a lot of fun even if I never managed to land a single hit. We should do it again sometime.
: What, like...D&D? You’d actually...want to play it again?
: Why do you seem so shocked to hear that?
: Because you’re cool and I’m a loser. And every second you spend with me is just slowly contaminating you.
: If hanging out with you makes me a loser, so be it. I think you’re pretty cool.
: Kiss!
: Blah, blah, blah! Praise me more! I did a good job! I’m the queen of the nerds! Move over, Molly! This is Farquad’s kingdom now!
: For the love of Alduin, just use your character’s name! It exists for a reason!
: Well Makoto — it’s only a matter of time now ‘til your girl goes up in flames. Hope ya enjoyed gettin’ to know me.
: You act like you’re competing against someone with an advantage. You’re up against Yasu, Miku. Her grades are only a little better than yours.
: That’s exactly the friggin’ problem, Makoto! This is Yasu we’re talkin’ about! How is she smarter than me?! She only knows about weird god stuff!
: What if we get friggin’ weird god questions?! What am I gonna do then, huh?
: Lose. But that’s also what would happen if Yasu were to get sports questions — which are a thing we have literally gotten in other trivia contests before.
: Wait, yeah! If we get questions about that stuff, there ain’t no way Yasu could beat me!
: I’ve just gotta stand my ground and play defense! Throw her off her game and interrupt her when it’s her turn to answer so she can’t ever get any words out!
: I believe that is against the rules, but go for it if it’s what makes you happy. Just be prepared for Imani to-
: Hello.
: Yo, Sensei! Whaddya say you take me to your office and gimme a tour of your fingers one last time before I suffer a trivia-related death?
: How did you even get in here? There’s no entrance that way.
: Ayane finally showed me her secret room. You wouldn’t believe what else is in there.
: I wager there are very few things I wouldn’t believe at this point.
: I’ll say! If ya believe in me when it comes to winnin’ this next contest, can’t imagine there’s much out there at all you wouldn’t be able to hop on board with.
: Oh, no. I don’t expect you to win at all. I think Yasu’s going to come out on top somehow.
: Well then what the heck was all of that positive reinforcement for?!
: Reaffirming our friendship and reminding you that the gap in your respective intellects isn’t as big as you think! Go Miku! Woohoo!
: Come on, Sensei. I don’t wanna die before gettin’ one last orgasm in.
: God, I really wish you never learned about sex.
: But I sometimes wish that I had never learned about it either as it is pretty consistently the root of many of my problems!
: Hey, same. But now that I know about it, I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
: Agreed. Which is why you should take me to your office instead of Miku. I know what I’m doing.
: Ay! That ain’t fair! You’ve had more time to learn! I’m still tryin’ to catch up! Come on, Sensei! We’re gettin’ outta-
: Nope! You’re not going anywhere, Miku. Because you need to get to the library and put our floor back on top!
: But if the first floor is on top of the second floor, doesn’t it become the second floor?! Meaning we can only win if we lose?!
: That...uhh...she’s...she’s kinda right, isn’t she?
: Weirdly enough, that might actually be the smartest thing I’ve ever heard Miku say.
: Well, it ain’t like there’s much competition!
